author: cheese_grader
quote:
This is easily my new favorite game! I stupidly wasted $80 on GTA, played it for a few hours with hope and excitement after waiting 13 years until I was just fed up and came back to this game. Seriously,  they remade a great classic and somehow made it better.  I love this game so much! 

Also,  don't waste your life or money on GTA. They obviously paid people for high reviews.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: cheese_grader
quote: There's so much wrong with this game,  but I just can't get past the fact I just wasted about 80 dollars to have a blue collar job and grow a conscious.
